data.title: 春寺由梨亚 · 客厅沙发抱枕微醺小酌与慵懒依恋
data.description: 【春寺由梨亚 · 客厅沙发抱枕微醺小酌与慵懒依恋】周末深夜温馨私密的公寓客厅内，电视里播放着老电影，暖黄色的落地灯将室内烘托得无比惬意。摘下眼镜的由梨亚整个人慵懒地蜷缩在柔软的真皮沙发深处，怀里紧紧抱着一只蓬松的毛绒抱枕。她身上穿着柔软舒适的宽松白衬衫与及膝棉袜，单手端着加冰的单一麦芽威士忌玻璃杯。几杯小酒下肚，白皙成熟的脸颊泛起诱人的微醺酡红，深蓝色的眼眸波光流转，带着罕见的少女般娇憨与依赖——「今晚……不准跟我谈工作上的事，就安安静静陪我看会儿电影吧……」
data.location: 暖黄落地灯下舒适的真皮大沙发上
data.action: 摘掉眼镜抱着软绵抱枕蜷缩在沙发上，手握威士忌酒杯，微醺脸颊绯红柔情凝望
data.lighting: 客厅落地灯暖金柔光与电视屏幕微光交织的温馨氛围
data.camera: medium shot, eye-level intimate framing, cozy sofa depth
data.promptProse: A wonderfully cozy and romantic slice-of-life anime illustration of Harudera Yuria (JB) from The Fruit of Grisaia relaxing on a plush leather sofa on a quiet weekend evening. With her signature red glasses set aside on the coffee table, her mature, delicate facial features, radiant sapphire eyes, and beauty mark are revealed in the warm amber glow of a living room floor lamp. Wearing a loose, comfortable white shirt and soft thigh-high socks, she hugs a fluffy cushion to her chest while holding a tumbler of whiskey on the rocks. Flushed with a pleasant, tipsy blush, she gazes affectionately at her partner with dreamy, loving eyes. Warm cinematic ambient lighting, domestic atmosphere, clean line art, no text.
